title: Machine learning prediction of food addiction in university students using demographic, anthropometric and personality traits.
summary: In a 210-student cross-sectional pilot, Random Forest/CatBoost models classify food-addiction labels from demographic, anthropometric and personality traits; BMI, age and personality associations are reported. Findings are exploratory with only 30 positive labels and no external validation.
